title: Orange Armored Warrior Sequence
description: A four-panel sequence showing a young Black woman with short curly hair in a dynamic action pose progression. She wears a detailed orange and black armored outfit with straps, pouches, and mechanical elements, performing combat movements with sparks and particle effects emanating from her right hand.
